content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SDDMASC Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Senior Resident posts at SDDMASC Delhi?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at Shri Dada Dev Matri Avum Shishu Chikitsalaya Delhi is scheduled for 30th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report within the specified registration timings.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a postgraduate Degree/Diploma/DNB in the relevant specialty from a recognized institution. A valid registration with the Delhi Medical Council (DMC) is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for General category candidates is 45 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST, OBC, and Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan) candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be paid as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix of Level 11, which ranges from Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700, along with other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 21 vacancies for the Senior Resident posts across various specialties at Shri Dada Dev Matri Avum Shishu Chikitsalaya Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The Senior Resident positions are on an Adhoc basis for a period of 44 days.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, DMC registration, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are advised to report for registration at the Administrative Block, SDDMASC between 9 AM to 11:30 AM on the interview date.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any experience required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must not have completed 03 years of Senior Residency in any recognized institution, including regular and adhoc periods.
